headlines.title: 'Relax, I love Kane and Lamine Yamal' - Henry defends his Ballon d'Or hosting
headlines.description: Former Arsenal forward Thierry Henry responds to criticism of a number of comments he made during Monday's Ballon d'Or ceremony and claims they were "jokes".

headlines.title: Russo scores hat-trick as Arsenal beat Benfica
headlines.description: Alessia Russo becomes England's all-time leading goalscorer in the Women's Champions League with a hat-trick in Arsenal's 3-0 win over Benfica.

headlines.title: Lawlor delighted after beating 'best team in the country'
headlines.description: Fleetwood Town manager Matt Lawlor could not hide his delight after seeing his team knock Premier League champions Arsenal out of the EFL Cup on penalties.
